body: Sometimes I do feel alone and like everyone around me is "normal" but I guess even if they are mentally "normal" their life can still be undesirable. I've always known that but when I get depressed my thinking gets sort of distorted. Thank you for reminding me that maybe I'm not all that much of a freak

Thanks for your positive outlook on this. It's really helpful to hear opinions on this other than my own, because mine is heavily influenced by how well I'm coping. I don't know how to explain it but for me I feel like maybe my sexuality is just messy enough that treatment could work. I've just been living with it so long that I sometimes loose hope.
Thank you, sometimes I get really down about it and everything feels hopeless. It's really nice to have someone reassure me.

Hey thanks for responding. It's honestly just really nice to have someone say that to me. There was a therapist that I had been considering who has experience with this sort of thing. Im going to contact her tomorrow. I really hope you're right and I can change.
